title: A one-script Next.js starter
tagline: create-next-app, then linting, commit rules, Redux, Ant Design and styled-components wired in one go.
intro: Every new client project started with the same afternoon of configuration. setup_v2.sh does it in one run, so the first commit already has the team's rules in it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: What the script does, in the order it does it.

blocks.caption: From an empty folder to a project with providers in its layout.

items.label: create-next-app
items.detail: Asks for a name with no spaces, then scaffolds the app in a folder of that name
explain: set -e stops the script at the first failing command, so a failed install never leaves a half-configured project behind.
Answer No to Tailwind in the prompts: styling comes from Ant Design and styled-components instead.

items.label: Code rules
items.detail: ESLint with Prettier, commitlint and Husky hooks run on every commit
explain: The ESLint config caps files at 150 lines, warns on console and forbids var, which keeps components small from the start.
The pre-commit hook runs lint-staged (eslint --fix, prettier --write); the commit-msg hook enforces Conventional Commits such as feat: add login.

items.label: plop scaffolding
items.detail: A plop generator creates the src folders and fills them from Handlebars templates
explain: It creates components, config, constants, features, helpers, hooks, libs, redux, themes and types, each with an index.ts.
Templates then write the Redux store and typed hooks, a hexToRgba helper, the styled-components registry and the themes.

items.label: AppProviders
items.detail: One client component nests every provider, and the root layout wraps the app in it
explain: Order, outermost first: Redux Provider, StyledComponentsRegistry, ThemeProvider, AntdRegistry, ConfigProvider, then GlobalStyle.
The registries collect styles during server rendering and inject them into the HTML, which is what stops a flash of unstyled content.
ConfigProvider is set to the Japanese locale (jaJP and dayjs 'ja'), because the template was made for Japanese client projects. Change both for other markets.

items: Put setup_v2.sh in the folder that should contain the new project.
